scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && cargo check --manifest-path native/terminald/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/terminald/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && cargo test --manifest-path native/terminald/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path native/terminald/crates/ghostty-adapter/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path native/terminald/crates/text-engine/Cargo.toml && npm run test:integration
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/desktop/src packages scripts tests *.json *.js *.md && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/terminald/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/desktop/src packages scripts tests *.json *.js *.md && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/terminald/Cargo.toml -- --check
